clinical.citation: Clinical and Genetic Analysis of SMARCC2-Related Diseases in Three Chinese Patients (PMID: 41532374)
clinical.diagnostic_reason: de novo variants identified by whole exome sequencing; variants at same codon (Arg116) suggest hotspot; clinical presentation consistent with SMARCC2-related neurodevelopmental disorder

clinical.citation: Long-read sequencing identifies a novel de novo inversion in SMARCC2 in a pediatric patient with Coffin-siris syndrome 8: a case report (PMID: 41291750)

variants.description: 233 kb inversion on chromosome 12 with breakpoint 1 disrupting SMARCC2 between exons 16 and 17

clinical.diagnostic_reason: de novo structural variant identified by long-read whole-genome sequencing; breakpoint disrupts SMARCC2 predicted to cause loss of function and haploinsufficiency; first reported structural variant in CSS8

clinical.citation: Exome sequencing in severe non-syndromic specific learning and language disorders in a French cohort (PMID: 41168819)

variants.description: SMARCC2 variants (2 patients, specific variants not detailed)

clinical.diagnostic_reason: pathogenic/likely pathogenic variants identified by exome sequencing in patients with severe non-syndromic specific learning disorders

clinical.citation: Cognitive and Synaptic Impairment Induced by Deficiency of Autism Risk Gene Smarcc2 and its Rescue by Histone Deacetylase Inhibition (PMID: 40492195)

variants.description: SMARCC2 diminishment in iPSC-derived neurons from idiopathic ASD patients
phenotypes: impaired GABAergic and glutamatergic synaptic currents

clinical.diagnostic_reason: SMARCC2 significantly diminished in iPSC-derived neurons from idiopathic ASD patients; genome-wide RNA-seq analysis; one of top-ranking risk genes for ASD

clinical.citation: DNA/RNA hybrid profiling in autistic patients: A focus on mRNA and non-coding RNA variations (PMID: 41183059)
clinical.diagnostic_reason: SMARCC2 confirmed upregulation by qRT-PCR validation in ASD patients; associated with DNA/RNA hybrids; differential expression analysis showed significant upregulation in ASD samples

biological.citation: The functional landscape of the human phosphoproteome (PMID: 31819260)
biological.summary: Machine learning analysis of 119,809 human phosphosites identified regulatory phosphosites in SMARCC2, a member of the SWI/SNF chromatin-remodeling complex, with a validated role in neuronal differentiation.

biological.citation: Elucidating the clinical and molecular spectrum of SMARCC2-associated NDD in a cohort of 65 affected individuals (PMID: 37551667)
biological.summary: Co-immunoprecipitation and proximity-ligation assays demonstrated altered BAF-subunit interactions for missense variants in SMARCC2, with 3D protein modeling showing decreased protein expression for N-terminal missense variants similar to loss-of-function variants.

biological.citation: SMARCC2 silencing suppresses oncogenic activation through modulation of chromatin accessibility in breast cancer (PMID: 38852505)
biological.summary: SMARCC2 silencing in breast cancer cells suppressed tumorigenesis and reduced cancer stem cell features via downregulation of the Ras-PI3K signaling pathway, demonstrated through cell proliferation assays, mammosphere formation, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq, and ChIP analyses.

biological.citation: Cognitive and Synaptic Impairment Induced by Deficiency of Autism Risk Gene Smarcc2 and its Rescue by Histone Deacetylase Inhibition (PMID: 40492195)
biological.summary: RNA-seq of iPSC-derived neurons from ASD patients showed significant diminishment of SMARCC2; ChIP-seq demonstrated SMARCC2 binding to multiple ASD risk genes involved in transcriptional regulation, and Smarcc2 deficiency in mouse prefrontal cortex impaired working memory with downregulation of synaptic transmission genes.
biological.sample_size: iPSC-derived neurons from idiopathic ASD patients; adolescent mice

biological.citation: Therapeutic targeting of CNBP phase separation inhibits ribosome biogenesis and neuroblastoma progression via modulating SWI/SNF complex activity (PMID: 37186134)
biological.summary: Co-immunoprecipitation and mass spectrometry identified SMARCC2 as a direct interaction partner of CNBP; CNBP liquid condensates repress SWI/SNF core subunit activity (SMARCC2/SMARCC1/SMARCA4) via interaction with SMARCC2, with low SMARCC2 levels associated with poor neuroblastoma patient survival.

biological.citation: FBXO28 promotes proliferation, invasion, and metastasis of pancreatic cancer cells through regulation of SMARCC2 ubiquitination (PMID: 37348029)
biological.summary: Immunoprecipitation-mass spectrometry identified SMARCC2 as a target of E3 ligase FBXO28; FBXO28 promotes pancreatic cancer progression by increasing SMARCC2 ubiquitination and protein degradation, with SMARCC2 upregulation reversing FBXO28-mediated oncogenic effects.

biological.citation: A novel SWI/SNF complex promotes triple-negative breast cancer progression (PMID: 40890601)
biological.summary: Mass spectrometry analysis identified SMARCC2 as an interacting protein of ARID1B; SMARCC2 forms a novel SWI/SNF complex with ARID1B and SMARCB1 that transcriptionally represses ZNF382 and promotes TNBC proliferation and migration.

biological.citation: Proteomic analysis reveals chromatin remodeling as a potential therapeutical target in neuroblastoma (PMID: 40011918)
biological.summary: Weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA) of neuroblastoma proteomic profiles identified SMARCC2 as one of 15 hub genes in a core prognostic module primarily related to chromatin remodeling and mRNA metabolic processes, associated with unfavorable subtype and high mitotic index.
biological.sample_size: NB tissue samples with pathological comparisons

biological.citation: SMARCC2 combined with c-Myc inhibits the migration and invasion of glioma cells via modulation of the Wnt/β-catenin signaling pathway (PMID: 34080022)
biological.summary: SMARCC2 overexpression in glioma cells significantly inhibited migration and invasion through co-immunoprecipitation-validated binding with c-Myc, downregulating c-Myc expression and suppressing Wnt/β-catenin signaling components (N-cadherin, vimentin, snail, β-catenin).
biological.sample_size: U87MG and LN229 glioma cell lines

biological.citation: ASHG 2018 - Expanding the spectrum of BAF-related disorders – de novo variants in SMARCC2 cause a syndrome with intellectual disability, developmental delay and growth retardation
biological.summary: Identified 15 individuals with de novo heterozygous SMARCC2 variants causing neurodevelopmental delay and growth retardation; variants in conserved DNA-interacting domains (SANT and SWIRM) presented more severe phenotypes; transcriptomic analysis of patient fibroblasts identified differentially expressed genes (H19, SCRG1, RELN, CACNB4) involved in neuronal development.
